AMIMeeting.name: AMI Meeting
AMIMeeting.terms_scope: Publisher manual annotations and transcripts. The original archive includes its CC BY 4.0 license and release notes.
AMIMeeting.included: All released words tracks plus all released named-entity tracks. Their native NXT ID links are preserved. The linked named-entity ontology is included.
AMIMeeting.excluded: Audio/video, summaries, gesture and other manual layers. Some speaker tracks have no named-entity layer.

AgCNER.name: AgCNER
AgCNER.citation: Hao et al., AgCNER dataset, Figshare. Files 42188205, 42188211 and 42188208.
AgCNER.terms_scope: The Figshare records for the three individual files identify CC0. This is the file-level grant.
AgCNER.included: Complete published train, development and test BIO files.
AgCNER.excluded: Models, collection-level guidelines and separate article.

AnEM.name: AnEM
AnEM.terms_label: CC BY-SA 3.0 annotations; publisher-specific text rights
AnEM.terms_scope: Preserve the bundled LICENSE and REFERENCES. PubMed abstracts retain their respective copyrights and PMC article fragments retain their article-specific OA licenses. Private research use for the combined token files.
AnEM.included: Both official train/test offset and BIO token files, including the source fragment ID lists.
AnEM.excluded: Parallel BRAT representations and alternate development partition.

BC2GMFull.name: BC2GM Full
BC2GMFull.terms_label: US public domain notice for government-authored database; original NOTICE applies
BC2GMFull.terms_scope: The release includes its original NLM public domain notice. Third-party material can retain independent rights.
BC2GMFull.included: Original train/test sentences, primary annotated spans and alternative accepted spans.
BC2GMFull.excluded: Derived development split and alternative BIO/standoff encodings.

CRAFT.name: CRAFT
CRAFT.edition: SHA-256 of the measured CRAFT repository ZIP
CRAFT.terms_label: CC BY 3.0 annotations; original OA article terms apply
CRAFT.terms_scope: The corpus license covers the annotations. Retain the article identifiers and upstream article/document notices for the underlying open access texts.
CRAFT.included: All 97 published CoNLL-U dependency-annotated articles and article-ID documentation.
CRAFT.excluded: Other ontology layers and parallel article encodings.

DistantListeningCorpus.name: Distant Listening Corpus
DistantListeningCorpus.citation: Hentschel et al., The Distant Listening Corpus, v3.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.15150283
DistantListeningCorpus.terms_scope: The publisher declares CC BY 4.0 for this release. Retain per-score metadata and associated corpus references.
DistantListeningCorpus.included: Complete combined expanded harmonic label table and corresponding score catalogue.
DistantListeningCorpus.excluded: Raw scores, notes, printed score facsimiles, and the parallel 1 GB project tree.

MedievalCharterNER.name: Medieval Charter NER
MedievalCharterNER.terms_scope: Zenodo record 6463699 identifies CC BY 4.0. Native per-member hashes match the measured documentation.
MedievalCharterNER.included: All four publisher files under datasets/, including annotations for persons, places, language and charter identifiers.
MedievalCharterNER.excluded: More than 15 GB of language models, embeddings, training logs and other release contents.

deposition_record.title: Multilingual named entity recognition for medieval charters. Datasets and models

TweetNERD.name: TweetNERD
TweetNERD.terms_scope: Twitter posts are not included. The public benchmark contains tweet IDs, surface phrases, spans, entity IDs and judgment scores. Platform terms govern any separate hydration.
TweetNERD.included: All 14 publisher public annotation TSVs: Academic, OOD and 12 unordered remainder files. Repeated IDs can occur across files.
TweetNERD.excluded: Tweet text, private material and hydration. The 12 files are not 12 separate named experimental splits.

RAMS.name: RAMS
RAMS.terms_label: CC BY-SA 4.0 annotations; linked news excerpts for research use
RAMS.terms_scope: The bundled LICENSE_info reserves third-party article copyrights, specifies research use and has a notice-and-takedown policy. Keep the combined windows in private research use.
RAMS.included: All three event-argument JSONLines files in version 1.0c.
RAMS.excluded: Code, alternate exports and original full news articles.

SemEval2013Task91.name: SemEval-2013 Task 9.1
SemEval2013Task91.terms_scope: Use for noncommercial research. DrugBank and MEDLINE source-text rights can apply independently of the corpus annotations.
SemEval2013Task91.included: Shared training XML and drug named-entity recognition task 9.1 test XML for DrugBank and MEDLINE, with supplied spans and relations.
SemEval2013Task91.excluded: Separate DDI extraction test task and packaging metadata.

DrugProtBioCreative.name: DrugProt
DrugProtBioCreative.terms_scope: Include publisher annotation tables only. Article texts retain their original rights.
DrugProtBioCreative.included: Complete training and development entity/relation tables and blinded test-background entity table, linked by PubMed IDs.
DrugProtBioCreative.excluded: All original abstract texts and unavailable blinded relationship labels.

deposition_record.title: DrugProt corpus: Biocreative VII Track 1 - Text mining drug and chemical-protein interactions

ELGold.name: ELGold
ELGold.terms_scope: The publisher identifies CC BY 4.0 for the deposited resource. The collection combines editorial and scientific sources. Preserve the original genre and document names.
ELGold.included: Complete publisher archive of inline English entity mentions and links in 11 genres.

DutchArchaeology.name: Dutch Archaeology NER
DutchArchaeology.terms_scope: The released README and embedded license apply GPL v3 to repository files. The Zenodo metadata uses other-open, and the source registry CC-BY label does not supersede the release.
DutchArchaeology.included: Complete combined gold BIO file for all six archaeological categories.
DutchArchaeology.excluded: Alternate per-user and per-document encodings and agreement samples.

measured_ledger_rows.split_or_subset: Brandsen's v1.0 complete-bio-gs.bio, all six archaeological categories

BBQ.name: BBQ
BBQ.terms_scope: Source questions and annotations covered by the publisher license. This is a bias evaluation corpus.
BBQ.included: All eleven released question JSONLines files, including the two intersectional categories.
BBQ.excluded: Generation templates, scores, ancillary metadata and analysis code.

WinoQueer.name: WinoQueer
WinoQueer.terms_scope: Includes the repository license, documentation and final paired benchmark.
WinoQueer.included: Full released paired bias-evaluation sentence CSV.

QxoRef.name: qxoRef
QxoRef.terms_scope: Native-speaker story transcripts and mention annotations are available under the noncommercial share-alike grant. Preserve the original source citation.
QxoRef.included: All twelve Conchucos Quechua stories in the release.
QxoRef.excluded: Separate underlying recordings and non-corpus resources.

MuDoCo.name: MuDoCo
MuDoCo.terms_scope: The publisher applies CC BY-NC 4.0. Each dialogue retains its published train/eval/test field.
MuDoCo.included: All six original domain files for calling, messaging, music, news, reminders and weather.

AmericasNLI.name: AmericasNLI
AmericasNLI.terms_scope: The dataset card identifies the authors’ attribution-share-alike license. The checked-in copy of that license applies to the NLI data.
AmericasNLI.included: Complete combined development and test files for all ten translated Latin American Indigenous languages, with per-language validation counts.
AmericasNLI.excluded: Language-specific copies of the same rows and unavailable gold training split.

GICoref.name: GICoref
GICoref.terms_label: BSD 3-Clause corpus grant; preserve underlying source notices
GICoref.terms_scope: The author datasheet identifies a BSD license. Source writers retain their independent rights. The datasheet and LICENSE accompany the corpus.
GICoref.included: The combined gold gender-inclusive coreference corpus.
GICoref.excluded: The distinct MAP corpus and publication.

ENer.name: E-NER (EDGAR-NER)
ENer.terms_scope: Include the attribution and noncommercial share-alike terms in the source README and license. Counts record labels outside BIO separately.
ENer.included: Complete combined all.csv token-level financial NER release.
ENer.excluded: Parallel SEC filing view and presentation documents.

FewRel.name: FewRel
FewRel.terms_label: MIT publisher repository; Wikipedia source text under CC BY-SA
FewRel.terms_scope: Research collection of Wikipedia-derived snippets and Wikidata entity identifiers. The repository license does not replace rights in Wikipedia contributions.
FewRel.included: Complete labeled Wikipedia train and validation files, including native subject/object position lists, plus the predicate dictionary.
FewRel.excluded: Unlabeled competition test answers, unrelated public-domain adaptation evaluation sets and benchmark scripts.

CoQAEntities.name: CoQA
CoQAEntities.edition: Stanford CoQA v1.0, selected author-licensed domains
CoQAEntities.terms_label: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the Wikipedia and literature domains
CoQAEntities.terms_scope: The publisher explicitly places the literature and Wikipedia passages under CC BY-SA 4.0. This edition selects only those two domains and preserves the source dialogue objects.
CoQAEntities.included: All Wikipedia and Project Gutenberg dialogues, questions, answers and source identifiers from published train and dev v1.0.
CoQAEntities.excluded: MCTest, RACE, CNN and hidden test data. The registry ID denotes conversational QA, not an entity-span benchmark.

terms_record.publisher_statement: Literature and Wikipedia passages are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

QUOREF.name: QUOREF
QUOREF.terms_label: CC BY 4.0 dataset; Wikipedia passage rights apply
QUOREF.terms_scope: AllenAI lists CC BY 4.0 for the corpus. Preserve the source Wikipedia titles and article information for underlying passages.
QUOREF.included: Complete original publisher JSON train and dev questions and released answer offsets, with the same partition counts as the direct ledger’s Parquet edition.
QUOREF.excluded: Hidden test labels and the parallel HF Parquet serialization.
QUOREF.quality_note: Native answer offsets disagree with the released paragraph slice for 416 of 22,266 training answer spans and 50 of 2,768 development answer spans. All affected answer strings occur elsewhere in their source paragraph. The original labels are preserved.

LojbanTatoeba.name: Lojban Tatoeba
LojbanTatoeba.terms_label: CC BY 2.0 as included in the OPUS release
LojbanTatoeba.terms_scope: Retain the Tatoeba contributor attribution, publisher README and original license. The two columns are parallel representations of the same pairs.
LojbanTatoeba.included: All aligned English and Lojban lines and original release notices.
LojbanTatoeba.excluded: Other Tatoeba language pairs, audio and raw downloads.

measured_ledger_rows.split_or_subset: 8 July 2026 OPUS Tatoeba English–Lojban parallel release

InterlingueWikipedia.name: Interlingue Wikipedia
InterlingueWikipedia.terms_label: CC BY-SA 4.0; individual Wikimedia exceptions apply
InterlingueWikipedia.terms_scope: Each retained article carries a permanent revision and history URL for attribution to Wikimedia contributors and article-specific sources. Article text is preserved as wikitext.
InterlingueWikipedia.included: Every current nonredirect main-namespace article in the 2026-11-01 Interlingue Wikipedia dump, with title, text, page/revision IDs and attribution links.
InterlingueWikipedia.excluded: Other namespaces, redirects, user/editor metadata and page histories.

measured_ledger_rows.split_or_subset: 1 November 2026, current revision, main-namespace nonredirect pages
